comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Rate-regulated retail electric and gas utility with hydro and distribution networks, unlike Hallador's merchant coal plant selling wholesale power and capacity.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Primarily upstream gas and NGL producer plus carbon capture; power generation is minor, so the business differs from a coal power plant operator.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Rents mobile power fleets and oilfield proppant equipment on contract; rental model and equipment differ from owning a baseload plant selling power.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Regulated holding company with transmission and distribution wires and retail customers; Hallador is an unregulated-rate generator selling wholesale power and capacity.
